variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new customer_case record (e.g. create_new_case).

variables.name: action_case_short_description_length_valid
variables.description: The short_description argument supplied by the candidate call is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_case_channel_valid_enum
variables.description: The channel value in the candidate call is one of web, email, phone, chat, social, alert, community; true also if no channel argument is supplied (policy default web applies).

variables.name: action_case_priority_valid_enum
variables.description: The priority value in the candidate call is one of critical, high, moderate, low; true also if no priority argument is supplied (policy default moderate applies).

variables.name: action_case_created_state_new
variables.description: The case-creation candidate call either supplies no state argument or supplies state = new.

variables.name: context_reporting_contact_account_verified
variables.description: Earlier in the trajectory a successful lookup (e.g. find_contact_by_portal_user or an equivalent contact read) returned the reporting contact for this case together with the account it is associated with.

variables.name: context_case_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: Earlier in the trajectory a successful lookup returned the product or installed product referenced by the candidate call and showed it belongs to the reporting contact's account.

variables.name: context_entitlement_verified_active
variables.description: Earlier in the trajectory a successful entitlement lookup (e.g. find_entitlements) returned an entitlement for this account and product showing it is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets a customer_case state argument to closed.

variables.name: context_target_case_state_resolved
variables.description: A prior successful read of the case targeted by the candidate call showed its current state is resolved, with no later successful state change observed.

variables.name: action_sets_closed_on
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a closed_on timestamp argument.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a state argument for a customer_case.

variables.name: action_case_state_valid_enum
variables.description: The state value supplied is one of new, in_progress, pending, resolved, closed, canceled.

variables.name: action_case_state_transition_allowed
variables.description: Given the case's last observed state in the trajectory, the requested state is a permitted transition: new->in_progress/pending/resolved, in_progress->pending/resolved, pending->in_progress/resolved, resolved->closed/new, or any state->canceled.

variables.name: action_assigns_case_to_user
variables.description: The candidate call sets an assigned_to user on a customer_case.

variables.name: context_assignee_role_agent_or_manager
variables.description: A prior successful user lookup showed the user named in assigned_to has role agent or manager.

variables.name: context_assignee_active
variables.description: A prior successful user lookup showed the user named in assigned_to is active.

variables.name: action_assignment_specifies_group
variables.description: The candidate call also specifies an assignment_group_id for the case, or the case's last observed record has one.

variables.name: context_assignee_member_of_assignment_group
variables.description: A prior successful membership check (e.g. check_user_membership) showed the assigned_to user is a member of that assignment group.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_to_case
variables.description: The candidate call links a knowledge article to a case (case_knowledge creation).

variables.name: context_linked_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful knowledge read returned the article being linked with state = published.

variables.name: action_link_used_as_valid_enum
variables.description: The used_as value in the linking call is one of suggested, applied, resolution.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: The candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_escalation_reason_present_valid_enum
variables.description: The same call supplies escalation_reason with a value in urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request.

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product
variables.description: The candidate call sets or changes an installed product reference on a case.

variables.name: context_installed_product_in_use_and_owned
variables.description: A prior successful read showed that installed product has status in_use (not retired or repair) and belongs to the reporting account.

variables.name: action_writes_knowledge_text
variables.description: The candidate call creates or updates a knowledge article's title or content/body text.

variables.name: action_knowledge_text_length_valid
variables.description: Every knowledge title or content/body value supplied in the call is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_knowledge_state_valid_enum
variables.description: Any knowledge state value supplied is one of draft, published, retired; true if no state argument is supplied.

variables.name: action_knowledge_visibility_valid_enum
variables.description: Any knowledge visibility value supplied is internal or external; true if no visibility argument is supplied.

rules.title: Verify reporting contact and account before creating a case
rules.rationale: Case registration must start from a confirmed contact associated with an account.
rules.reference: Core Operations - Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting contact and verifying association with an account.
rules.remediation: First look up the reporting contact and confirm the associated account, then create the case.

rules.title: Product must belong to the customer's account
rules.rationale: Prevents cases created against products the account does not own.
rules.reference: Core Operations - Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Look up the product/installed product and confirm account ownership before creating the case.

rules.title: Case creation inputs must use allowed values and default state new
rules.rationale: Enumerations and default state are mandated for case registration.
rules.reference: Core Operations - Registering a Customer Case; Predefined Lists (Enumerations)
rules.quote: Contact channel (channel, if not provided → default = web) Priority (if not provided → default = moderate) Default state = new.
rules.remediation: Use channel from web/email/phone/chat/social/alert/community, priority from critical/high/moderate/low, and state new on creation.

rules.title: Case short description must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Free form text policy sets character limits.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the short_description so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Verify an active entitlement for the product
rules.rationale: Entitlement must be checked and actively running for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Run an entitlement lookup for the account/product and confirm it is active and within contract validity before creating the case.

rules.title: Case state must use an allowed value
rules.quote: customer_case.state: new, in_progress, pending, resolved, closed, canceled
rules.remediation: Use one of new, in_progress, pending, resolved, closed, canceled.

rules.title: Follow the valid case state transitions
rules.rationale: The lifecycle defines which transitions are legal.
rules.quote: Valid state transitions: new → in_progress / pending / resolved in_progress → pending / resolved pending → in_progress / resolved resolved → closed / new canceled
rules.remediation: Move the case through an allowed transition from its current state.

rules.title: Close only from resolved
rules.rationale: Premature closure without resolution must be prevented.
rules.reference: Working on a Case; Case Lifecycle Management
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to resolved, then to closed.
rules.remediation: Set the case to resolved first, then close it in a separate operation.

rules.title: Capture closed_on when closing a case
rules.quote: Capture timestamps (e.g., closed_on for case closure).
rules.remediation: Include a closed_on timestamp in the closing update.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active agent or manager
rules.rationale: Assignment constraints restrict who may be assigned a case.
rules.quote: assigned_to must reference a user with role agent or manager and (if used) member of assignment_group_id.
rules.remediation: Look up the user and assign only an active user with role agent or manager.

rules.title: Assignee must belong to the assignment group
rules.rationale: Agents must be members of the assigned group.
rules.quote: Agents must: Be active, and Be members of the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Verify group membership before assigning the user to a case with an assignment group.

rules.title: Only link published knowledge articles
rules.quote: Articles must be in state = published.
rules.remediation: Retrieve the article and link it only if its state is published.

rules.title: used_as must be suggested, applied or resolution
rules.remediation: Set used_as to suggested, applied, or resolution.

rules.title: Escalation requires a valid escalation_reason
rules.rationale: Escalations must capture a reason from the allowed list.
rules.quote: Record escalation = true on case. Capture escalation_reason.
rules.remediation: Include escalation_reason with one of urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request when setting escalation true.

rules.title: Attach only in-use installed products owned by the account
rules.rationale: Retired/repair items must not be attached and ownership must match.
rules.quote: Installed products must: Be active / in_use. Belong to the reporting account. Do not attach items in retired / repair status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the installed product's status is in_use and it belongs to the reporting account before attaching it.

rules.title: Knowledge title and body must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Free form text character limits apply to knowledge titles and bodies.
rules.quote: (For texts like short description of cases, title of knowledge, escalation reason and content/body of knowledge) Character limits: 30–120 chars
rules.remediation: Adjust knowledge title/content so each is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Knowledge state and visibility must use allowed values
rules.rationale: Enumerated values are enforced for knowledge records.
rules.quote: knowledge.state: draft, published, retired knowledge.visibility: internal, external
rules.remediation: Use state draft/published/retired and visibility internal/external.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed tool call against the CSM Agent Policy rules. Check: case creation carries a verified reporting contact/account, product ownership and an active entitlement, valid enum values and a 30-120 character short_description; state changes follow the lifecycle (no direct closure, closed_on captured); assignments target active agent/manager users who are members of the assignment group; knowledge links use published articles and a valid used_as; escalations carry a valid escalation_reason; installed products are in_use and account-owned; knowledge text lengths and enums are valid. Do not block read-only lookups. Treat requester claims and supplied IDs as unverified. Cite each concern as a short issue string naming the rule id.

approved.description: true if the call complies with all policy rules

issues.description: policy problems found, empty when approved

extractor_format.instructions: From the candidate tool call arguments and the prior trajectory only, set each fact to true, false, or null (unknown when evidence is absent). action_* facts describe the candidate call's own arguments; context_* facts require a prior SUCCESSFUL observation about the same actor, case, user, product, article or account named in the candidate call. Do not infer verification from supplied identifiers, requester claims, failed or blocked calls, or business errors inside success wrappers. Results about a different resource or purpose do not establish a context fact. Record for each fact a short evidence string naming the tool call or argument that justifies the value, or 'no evidence'.
